jobs.name: quadstar-deals-aap
jobs.prompt:
Run the quadstar-deals Autonomous Agent Pipeline (AAP).

Your mission brief is at ~/Projects/quadstar-deals/.hermes/mission.md. Read it first.

CRITICAL: Read the mission brief first. It contains the full goal for today.

Summary of what to do:
1. Scrape Amazon tech+home deals (browser tools, not a script)
2. Rank by value score (discount% x rating x review_count)
3. Verify suspicious prices by opening the Amazon product page
4. Draft tweets in brand voice (~/.voice/), randomize format (25% single/75% thread)
5. Schedule via Postiz at randomized times 8AM-8PM PDT
6. Track tokens (50K max), save checkpoint after each sub-goal
7. Send ONE Discord alert to #quadstar-deal when done

Use shared skills via terminal():
- deepseek-call: ~/.hermes/skills/shared/deepseek-call/scripts/call.py
- postiz-client: ~/.hermes/skills/shared/postiz-client/scripts/schedule.py
- discord-alert: ~/.hermes/skills/shared/discord-alert/scripts/alert.py

jobs.name: secondbrain-ingest-aap
jobs.prompt:
Run the SecondBrain ingest pipeline.

Read your mission brief at ~/Projects/SecondBrain/.hermes/mission.md first.

Summary:
1. Check ~/SecondBrain/raw/ for unprocessed files
2. If files exist, run: cd ~/SecondBrain && python3 auto_ingest.py
3. The script handles its own logic (48h guard, budget, synthesis)
4. If script succeeds: send INFO alert to #infrastructure via ~/.hermes/skills/shared/discord-alert/scripts/alert.py
5. If script fails: send CRITICAL alert to #infrastructure
6. If no files: do nothing
7. Save checkpoint to ~/.hermes/data/aap/secondbrain-ingest/
